evals.prompt: Analyze a steady 16-bar rhythm part whose one-bar cell repeats throughout, but whose musical phrase is four bars.
evals.expected_output: Select the coherent four-bar phrase ahead of the embedded one-bar fragment, unless the one-bar cell has a separately documented live-loop purpose.
expectations: Equivalent coverage favors the coherent four- or eight-bar phrase.
At most three core patterns are selected for the source instrument by default.
A short exception includes a concrete musical selection_reason.

evals.prompt: Two eight-bar background-guitar passages each contain seven silent bars, but their only sounding final bars are different. Decide whether this is one near-loop.
evals.expected_output: Do not classify the passages as a near-loop merely because their rests align; record the different sounding material as distinct or live/unresolved evidence.
expectations: Shared silence alone never establishes a near-loop.
The different sounding bars remain explicit.
No canonical loop decision is invented from silence-only similarity.

evals.prompt: A 14-bar bridge contains a 12-bar repeating body and a distinct two-bar ending on the same source guitar track. Build the ordered analysis sections.
evals.expected_output: Represent a 12-bar bridge-body sub-block followed by a two-bar bridge-ending sub-block. Do not activate body and ending loops simultaneously for all 14 bars and do not use a tail policy to move the ending.
expectations: active_pattern_ids are treated as simultaneous for a whole block.
The two-bar ending starts only after the 12-bar body.
Total bridge length remains exactly 14 bars.

evals.prompt: A source has six tracks, but one is live-only, one is omitted optional doubling, and no material remains unresolved. Prepare a finalization-ready handoff.
evals.expected_output: Keep all source tracks in the evidence manifest, but expect executable output lanes only for placed loops and the used live role. Do not create empty unresolved or omitted-only output tracks.
expectations: No unused output role is counted toward export capacity.
The analysis preflight reports selected-loop and section-timing readiness honestly.
